Fierce Snarl.prompt: A fierce animal-like snarl. Her upper lip curls high to bare the canine teeth and upper gums, the nose wrinkles into deep folds, the nostrils flare, and the mouth corners pull sharply backward. Her jaw thrusts forward so both rows of teeth are visible, while her eyes narrow into a hard threatening stare beneath lowered brows.

Baring Teeth.prompt: Baring her teeth, her upper lip peels high upward, exposing the canine teeth and upper gums in a fierce threat display. The nose wrinkles into deep folds, the nostrils flare wide, and the mouth corners pull sharply backward. Her jaw thrusts forward, the lower teeth show beneath the lifted lip, and her eyes narrow into a hard, hostile stare beneath lowered brows.

Animal Snarl.prompt: Baring her teeth, her lips rip back from her teeth in a full animal-like snarl. The upper lip lifts almost to the nostrils, exposing the canines, front teeth, and a strip of gum. The nose is crushed upward into deep wrinkles, the nostrils flare, the jaw juts forward, and both rows of teeth are bared. Her eyes narrow to slits and lock forward under steeply lowered brows.

Feral Threat.prompt: Baring her teeth in a feral threat display. Her upper lip is curled high and tight, baring the canine teeth and gums like an angry dog warning before a bite. The nose wrinkles sharply, the cheeks tense, the mouth corners pull back, and the jaw pushes forward so the teeth are fully presented. Her nostrils flare and her eyes glare forward from beneath low, aggressive brows.

Canine Snarl.prompt: Baring her teeth in a fierce canine-like snarl, upper lip curled high, canine teeth and gums exposed, nose wrinkled, nostrils flared, mouth corners pulled back, jaw thrust forward, lower teeth visible, narrowed hostile eyes, lowered aggressive brows.

Teeth Bared Wide.prompt: Baring her teeth. Her lips are pulled back tautly away from each other, fully exposing both upper and lower gumlines and aligned rows of teeth. The corners of her mouth are pulled sharply outward toward her jawline, cheek muscles tightened upward. Her eyelids are stretched wide, exposing white sclera around her irises under slightly elevated eyebrows.

Biting Lower Lip.prompt: Biting her lower lip. Her mouth is visibly parted, exposing her upper front incisors as they clamp down on the thick center of her lower lip. The bitten section of the lower lip is folded upward and pulled deep beneath the upper teeth, visibly pinched and compressed between them. The remaining lower lip bulges below the bite, both mouth corners pull outward, and her chin wrinkles beneath the compressed lip. Her eyes look directly forward beneath lowered upper eyelids.

Aroused Lip Bite.prompt: An intensely aroused lower-lip bite. Her lips are wet and parted wide enough to clearly expose her upper incisors clamped around the thick center of her lower lip, pulling it deeply inward while the unbitten sides remain swollen and pushed forward. Her cheeks, nose, ears, and upper chest are flushed deep pink. Her pupils are enlarged, her upper eyelids hang heavily over a fixed direct stare, and her lower eyelids rise slightly beneath the eyes. One mouth corner lifts into a faint crooked smile, her nostrils are slightly flared, and her chin tilts downward so she looks upward through half-closed eyes.

Sensual Lip Bite.prompt: A sensual lower-lip bite. Her lips are slightly parted, clearly showing her upper front teeth gently holding the full center of her lower lip and drawing it inward in a slow deliberate bite. The bitten section of the lip is softly folded beneath the teeth while the rest of the lower lip stays full and plush. Her cheeks are faintly flushed, her mouth stays relaxed at the corners, and her eyes look forward beneath heavy half-lidded eyelids.

Deep Lip Bite.prompt: Her upper front teeth bite deeply into the center of her lower lip. The lower lip is visibly trapped beneath the incisors, folded inward and flattened by the teeth, with the unbitten portion swelling outward below them. Her mouth corners stretch apart so the tooth-to-lip contact is completely visible, and her chin dimples beneath the pressure.

Firm Lip Bite.prompt: She bites down firmly on the center of her lower lip, clearly exposing her upper incisors. The lower lip folds upward beneath the teeth and bulges around the bite. One mouth corner pulls higher than the other, one cheek dimples, her chin lowers, and her eyes look upward beneath heavy lowered lids.

Exaggerated Lip Bite.prompt: Exaggerated lower-lip bite, mouth clearly parted, upper incisors visibly clamped onto the center of the lower lip, lower lip folded inward beneath the teeth, bitten section deeply compressed, remaining lower lip bulging outward, mouth corners stretched apart, wrinkled chin, direct gaze.

Sensual Bottom Lip Bite.prompt: Sensually biting her bottom lip. Her upper front incisors press firmly into the fleshy center of her lower lip, drawing it inward and flattening it slightly against her teeth. The upper lip rests relaxed above her exposed teeth, while her eyebrows are drawn soft and level. Her gaze is focused directly forward beneath slightly heavy, relaxed upper eyelids.

Gentle Lip Bite.prompt: Biting her lip. One side of her upper teeth presses gently down onto her lower lip, pulling it slightly skew into her mouth. Her cheeks show a faint tension near the jaw, while her gaze holds steady. Her brows rest in a subtle, soft arch with a light warmth across the bridge of her nose.

Blushing.prompt: Blushing. A deep reddish-pink flush spreads prominently across the bridge of her nose, high cheekbones, and soft tissue of her cheeks. Her eyes are cast slightly downward beneath lowered eyelids, brows relaxed with a tiny central dip. Her mouth is set in a soft, closed-lip curve with subtle dimpling at the corners.

Crying.prompt: Crying. Her forehead wrinkles in the center as the inner corners of her eyebrows are pulled tightly upward and together into a steep angle. Her lower eyelids are puffed and squeezed upward, with wet tear tracks glistening down her flushed cheeks. Her lower lip trembles violently while her mouth hangs parted with downturned corners.

Growling.prompt: Growling aggressively. Her upper lip is retracted tightly upward to expose her front upper teeth and gums, while her nose is heavily wrinkled with deep vertical ridges along the bridge. Her nostrils flare wide, and her eyebrows are pulled low and steeply inward into a deep furrow over narrowed, fiercely staring eyes.

Laughing.prompt: Laughing. Her mouth is wide open in an unconstrained crescent, top and bottom teeth fully visible, while her cheek muscles pull high into prominent rounded apples. Deep crow's feet crease the outer corners of her tightly squeezed, crescent-shaped eyes. Her eyebrows sit arched and high on a smooth forehead.

Ahegao.prompt: Making the ahegao face. Her eyes are rolled dramatically upward and outward into her head so only the lower white sclera are visible beneath half-lidded upper lashes. Her tongue is fully extended downward past her chin with a wet, glistening shine. Her cheeks are intensely flushed dark pink, and her mouth is stretched open in an exaggerated gasp.

Orgasming.prompt: Orgasming. Her head is tilted backward with taut neck tendons, eyes heavily fluttering or half-lidded with her gaze unaligned and unfocused. Her mouth is parted open in a gasping oval showing her upper teeth, lower jaw relaxed. Her cheeks are intensely flushed, with cheekbones drawn high and forehead smooth.

Rolling Eyes.prompt: Rolling her eyes. Her irises and pupils are rotated all the way to the top outer edges of her eye sockets, exposing the white sclera beneath her irises. Her upper eyelids lift high while her eyebrows arch slightly upward without creasing her forehead. Her lips remain pressed together in a flat, indifferent line.

Sighing.prompt: Sighing. Her lips are softly parted as a deep stream of air drops her lower jaw downward into a slack, relaxed position. Her eyelids droop heavy and relaxed over downcast pupils, while her eyebrows sit low and completely uncreased. Her neck muscles relax as her chin dips slightly toward her chest.

Tongue Out.prompt: Sticking out her tongue. Her lips are parted into a wide, soft circle, and her flat tongue is protruded forward over her lower lip, extending past her chin. Her upper eyelids are slightly widened, showing full pupils, while her eyebrows are raised in a smooth, effortless arch across an unwrinkled forehead.

Tongue Out Cross Eyed.prompt: Sticking out her tongue and crossing her eyes. Both of her pupils are turned sharply inward toward the bridge of her nose in an extreme cross-eyed gaze. Her mouth is held wide open with her tongue protruded flatly straight outward over her bottom lip. Her eyebrows are hitched at uneven heights, creasing her forehead asymmetrically.

Cross Eyed.prompt: Crossing her eyes. Her eyeballs are rotated inward toward her nose so both pupils align near the inner lacrimal caruncles, exposing the outer sclera. Her eyebrows rest level and low over her narrowed eyelids. Her mouth is closed in a neutral horizontal line with jaw relaxed and cheeks still.

Screaming.prompt: Screaming. Her mouth is stretched wide open into a tall vertical rectangle with her jaw fully dropped, tongue flattened at the base, and throat exposed. Her nostrils are dilated wide, and her upper eyelids are pulled back to reveal her full irises. Her eyebrows are drawn high and furrowed sharply in the center, creasing her forehead.

Winking.prompt: Winking. One eye is clamped completely shut with tight fan-like wrinkles creasing its outer corner and her cheek pulled high beneath it. Her opposite eye remains wide open and focused forward under a slightly raised eyebrow. Her lips are curled into a subtle, knowing half-smile that tugs up on the side of the closed eye.

Bashful.prompt: A bashful facial expression. Her face is turned slightly down and away from the viewer while her gaze is cast back upward through lowered upper lashes. Her cheekbones are flushed with a warm crimson bloom, and her eyebrows are drawn up slightly in the center. Her mouth is set in a tight, timid closed smile with compressed lips.

Cheeky.prompt: A cheeky facial expression. Her head is tilted sideways with one shoulder slightly raised, her mouth pulled into a lopsided grin that elevates one lip corner higher than the other. The tip of her tongue is lightly pressed against the inside of her lower lip. One eyebrow is arched upwards playfully while her eyes focus intently on the viewer.

Come Hither.prompt: A come hither look on her face. Her chin is lowered slightly so her gaze angles upward directly at the viewer beneath heavy, relaxed eyelids and smooth brows. Her lips are parted just enough to reveal a sliver of her upper front teeth, with the corners tugged into a subtle smirk. A warm, faint flush accentuates her cheekbones.

Confused.prompt: A confused facial expression. Her eyebrows are drawn together and pulled downward into an uneven V-shape with vertical furrows between them. Her eyes are narrowed into an asymmetrical squint, with one brow higher than the other. Her head is tilted sharply to one side, and her lips are pressed into a tight, slightly crooked horizontal line.

Contemptuous.prompt: A contemptuous facial expression. One upper lip corner is pulled upward in a sharp, asymmetrical lift, exposing a single canine tooth while the rest of her mouth remains flat. Her head is tilted backward slightly with her gaze looking down her nose at the viewer. One eyebrow is faintly elevated while her eyelids droop into a cold, heavy stare.

Coy.prompt: A coy facial expression. Her chin is tucked downward toward her shoulder while her eyes look up from beneath lowered lashes with a soft, steady focus. Her lips are pressed into a closed, subtle smile that pulls slightly to one side, dimpling her cheek. A faint pink flush warms her cheekbones, and her eyebrows sit smoothly arched.

Cruel.prompt: A cruel facial expression. Her lower eyelids are tensed straight and hard beneath steeply sloped, drawn-down eyebrows that knot over the bridge of her nose. Her lips are pulled into a razor-thin, cold horizontal smile with no warmth, exposing only the edges of her upper teeth. Her chin is raised assertively while her eyes maintain a hard, unblinking glare.

Determined.prompt: A determined facial expression. Her jaw is clenched firmly with the masseter muscle bulging visibly at the angle of her jaw. Her lips are pressed into a tight, flat, rigid line, and her eyebrows are pulled straight down and inward into a focused furrow. Her eyes are wide and fixed directly forward in an unblinking, unwavering stare.

Disapproving.prompt: A disapproving facial expression. Her lips are pressed tightly together into a flat, thin line with distinctly downturned corners. Her eyebrows are drawn down into a slight central furrow, creasing the skin between her eyes. Her nostril wings are slightly rigid, and her head is held stiff and level, looking directly forward.

Disgusted.prompt: A disgusted facial expression. Her upper lip is pulled sharply upward into a snarl, heavily wrinkling her nose with deep vertical ridges across the bridge. Her lower lip is pushed forward slightly, and her eyes are narrowed beneath lowered, furrowed eyebrows. Her head pulls back slightly from the viewer with tense neck tendons.

Distressed.prompt: A distressed facial expression. The inner corners of her eyebrows are pulled sharply upward and together, creating deep vertical and horizontal lines across the center of her forehead. Her mouth hangs open with downturned lip corners, her lower lip trembling noticeably. Her eyes are wide, shiny with wet reflections, and framed by tense, puffed lower eyelids.

Doe Eyed.prompt: A doe-eyed facial expression. Her eyelids are opened extremely wide to reveal large, fully visible pupils and bright white sclera around her irises. Her eyebrows are raised high in smooth, uncreased arches across a smooth forehead. Her cheek muscles are soft and relaxed, while her lips rest softly parted in an innocent, neutral posture.

Euphoric.prompt: A euphoric facial expression. Her head is tilted backward with her face upturned toward the sky, eyelids gently closed or fluttering half-shut in complete ecstasy. Her cheek muscles are raised high into full, rounded shapes, pulling her mouth open in a soft, breathy smile that reveals her upper teeth. Her forehead and brow are entirely smooth and tension-free.

Fierce.prompt: A fierce facial expression. Her eyebrows are pulled low and sharp over piercing, wide-open eyes, accentuating an intense, forward-facing glare. Her nostrils are flared wide, her jaw is set firmly forward, and her upper lip is slightly lifted to expose the edges of her front teeth. Tight muscle tension is visible across her cheeks and bridge of the nose.

Flirtatious.prompt: A flirtatious facial expression. Her head is tilted to the side while her eyes look through lowered, long lashes with an intently focused gaze. One eyebrow is subtly raised higher than the other, creating a playful contrast. Her glossy lips are slightly parted, with one corner tugged upward into a warm, inviting smirk.

Frustrated.prompt: A frustrated facial expression. Her eyebrows are tightly drawn together, creating vertical creases above the bridge of her nose while her eyes are squeezed semi-shut. Her teeth are clamped tightly together inside slightly parted, taut lips. Her cheek muscles and jawline are visibly strained with deep tension.

Furious.prompt: A furious facial expression. Her forehead is heavily creased with inner brows pulled sharply downward, creating a deep V-shape above her nose. Her eyes are wide and glaring intensely forward, her nostrils are flared wide, and her jaw is thrust forward. Her lips are stretched taut and pulled back to bare her clenched teeth in an open snarl.

Grossed Out.prompt: A grossed out facial expression. Her tongue is slightly protruded between her parted teeth while the skin over the bridge of her nose is pulled into tight vertical creases. Her lower lip is pushed out in an accentuated pout of aversion. Her eyes are squinted shut into tight slits, and her entire head leans back away from the front.

Happy.prompt: A happy facial expression. Her lips are curved smoothly upward at both corners in a broad, radiant smile that reveals a full row of upper teeth. Her cheek muscles are raised high into prominent round apples, pushing against her lower eyelids. Deep, gentle crow's feet crinkle the outer corners of her sparkling, crescent-shaped eyes.

Haughty.prompt: A haughty facial expression. Her head is tilted backward with her chin pointing distinctly upward, forcing her gaze to look downward past heavy, half-closed eyelids. Her forehead remains entirely smooth and unwrinkled above relaxed eyebrows. Her mouth is set in a slight, dismissive closed-lip curve that turns up subtly at only one corner.

Horny.prompt: A horny facial expression. Her upper eyelids droop heavily over dilated pupils, creating a dark, intense gaze focused directly on the viewer. Her lower lip is slightly swollen and drawn inward, caught gently beneath her upper front teeth. Her nostrils are flared with rhythmic breathing, and a warm flush coats her cheekbones.

Hungry.prompt: A hungry facial expression. Her eyes are widened and locked intently on her target, her pupils slightly expanded with eager focus. The tip of her tongue trails across her upper lip, leaving a glistening wet shine as her lower jaw drops slightly open. Her cheekbones are high, and her mouth forms a focused, anticipatory smile.

Disdain.prompt: A look of disdain on her face. Her head is drawn back slightly, her nose upturned as if reacting to an unpleasant odor. A single side of her upper lip sneers upward in a cold curl, showing a glimpse of her canine tooth. Her eyelids droop into a flat, unblinking glare beneath level, unmoving eyebrows.

Outraged.prompt: A look of outrage on her face. Her jaw drops open in stunned disbelief, her mouth forming a tense, rectangular gasp showing both sets of teeth. Her eyes are stretched to their absolute widest, showing white sclera all around her irises. Her eyebrows are pulled extremely high and drawn together in the center, forming deep horizontal lines on her forehead.

Sensual Longing.prompt: A look of sensual longing on her face. Her lips are softly parted in a gentle exhale, her lower lip slightly fuller and glistening under soft lighting. Her eyelids droop into a heavy, languid posture over dilated pupils that gaze steadily forward. Her eyebrows rest in a subtle, relaxed arch, and a gentle heat warms her high cheekbones.

Lovestruck.prompt: A lovestruck facial expression. Her pupils are noticeably dilated, creating large, glossy eyes that lock onto the viewer with an unblinking, tender gaze. Her eyebrows are lifted smoothly in the center, softening her brow line. Her mouth is curved into a wide, open-lipped smile that highlights her rounded cheeks and exposed upper teeth.

Lustful.prompt: A lustful facial expression. Her eyelids droop low into a heavy, focused gaze while her nostrils flare subtly with rhythmic breathing. Her jaw is relaxed, leaving her mouth slightly open with her lower lip pressed gently against her upper teeth. Her cheekbones are flushed dark crimson, and her brows rest low and flat over her eyes.

Mischievous.prompt: A mischievous facial expression. One corner of her mouth hitches sharply upward into an asymmetrical smirk, pulling her cheek into a subtle dimple. Her eyelids narrow into a sharp, knowing gaze, and one eyebrow arches slightly higher than the other. Her head is tilted downward, forcing her eyes to look up at the viewer playfully.

Mocking.prompt: A mocking facial expression. Her tongue is pushed firmly against the inside of her lower cheek, creating a visible bulge on one side of her face. One eyebrow is raised high while the other dips downward in an asymmetrical slant over narrowed eyes. Her mouth curls into an open, crooked sneer that exposes her canine teeth.

Neutral.prompt: A neutral facial expression. All facial muscles are completely relaxed with no visible tension around her eyes, forehead, or mouth. Her lips rest gently together in a flat horizontal line, with her jaw relaxed and unclenched. Her eyelids sit at a natural height over centered pupils beneath flat, level eyebrows.

Pained.prompt: A pained facial expression. Her eyebrows are pulled tightly together and angled sharply upward in the center, creasing her forehead into vertical lines. Her eyes are squeezed tightly shut with deep crow's feet creasing the outer corners. Her mouth is pulled into a strained grimace, drawing her lips back to expose clenched teeth.

Panicked.prompt: A panicked facial expression. Her eyes are opened to their absolute limit, exposing bright white sclera entirely surrounding her dilated irises. Her eyebrows are drawn high and squeezed together into a tight, strained knot over the bridge of her nose. Her mouth is pulled wide into a rectangular gasp with taut neck muscles visible.

Pensive.prompt: A pensive facial expression. Her gaze is directed upward and slightly off-center in a quiet, unfocused stare away from the viewer. Her eyebrows are drawn together into a mild, thoughtful furrow directly between her eyes. Her lips are softly compressed together, with the index finger of one hand resting lightly against her lower lip.

Playful.prompt: A playful facial expression. Her head tilts back slightly as her eyes sparkle with light, framed by gentle fan-like creases at the outer corners. Her mouth is open in a wide half-smile, showing her upper teeth with the tip of her tongue lightly touching behind them. Her eyebrows sit comfortably high on a smooth forehead.

Pouting.prompt: A pouting facial expression. Her lower lip is pushed distinctly outward, extending past her upper lip in a full, pronounced swell. Her eyebrows are drawn into a soft central furrow while her eyes gaze upward from beneath lowered eyelids. Her cheek muscles relax while her chin puckers slightly into an orange-peel texture.

Relieved.prompt: A relieved facial expression. Her eyelids softly close as a deep breath drops her lower jaw into a slight, relaxed opening between her lips. Her eyebrows smooth completely flat, lowering back to a neutral resting position across an uncreased forehead. The tension drains from her jawline and cheek muscles as her head tilts forward.

Sad.prompt: A sad facial expression. The inner corners of her eyebrows are pulled upward and tightly together, slanting down toward the outer edges of her eyes. Her upper eyelids droop heavily, casting a shadow over downcast pupils. The corners of her closed mouth are drawn downward, and her chin skin is subtly pebbled with tension.

Scared.prompt: A scared facial expression. Her upper eyelids are retracted high into her brow, exposing the full circle of her irises and white sclera. Her eyebrows are pulled up and flattened straight across her forehead into deep horizontal lines. Her mouth hangs open with the corners pulled back tautly toward her ears in a frozen gasp.

Seductive.prompt: A seductive facial expression. Her head tilts downward as her eyes angle upward, holding a steady, focused gaze beneath lowered, heavy eyelids. Her lips are full and slightly parted, revealing just the tips of her upper front teeth. A soft, subtle dimple forms near one corner of her mouth as her cheek sits high and warm.

Serene.prompt: A serene facial expression. Her eyelids rest gently shut or float in a calm, steady gaze with a complete absence of tension around the eye sockets. Her forehead is entirely smooth, with brows resting in a soft, natural arch. Her lips are lightly sealed in a faint, barely perceptible closed-mouth smile that softens her jawline.

Shocked.prompt: A shocked facial expression. Her lower jaw drops completely open, forming an exaggerated vertical oval with exposed front teeth and tongue. Her eyelids are pulled back to reveal the full circumference of her irises without blinking. Her eyebrows are hitched as high as possible up her forehead, creating clean horizontal creases.

Shy.prompt: A shy facial expression. Her face is turned downward and away, with her eyes darting sideways to steal a brief glance at the viewer. A bright crimson flush spreads prominently across her cheekbones and the bridge of her nose. Her lips are pressed into a tight, timid closed smile with compressed corners.

Silly.prompt: A silly facial expression. Her eyes are crossed inward toward her nose while her tongue sticks out sideways from the corner of a wide, open mouth. One eyebrow is hitched high up her forehead while the other is compressed low over her eyelid. Her cheeks are scrunched up asymmetrically in a goofy contortion.

Skeptical.prompt: A skeptical facial expression. One of her eyebrows is arched high up her forehead into a distinct U-shape while the other is drawn low and narrowed over her eye. Her lips are pulled to one side in a tight, uneven, horizontal line. Her head tilts slightly backward as she stares out through narrowed eyelids.

Sleepy.prompt: A sleepy facial expression. Her upper eyelids droop low over dull, unfocused pupils, covering more than half of her eyes. Her eyebrows sit completely slack and flat across a smooth, unwrinkled forehead. Her lower jaw hangs slightly loose, parting her lips in a soft, inactive opening as her neck muscle tension vanishes.

Smirk.prompt: A smirk. One single corner of her mouth is hitched upward into a tight, sharp curve, tugging the skin into a subtle cheek dimple. Her opposite lip corner rests completely flat and still in a closed-mouth line. Her eyelids are narrowed slightly in a knowing gaze while one eyebrow arches faintly higher than the other.

Smug.prompt: A smug facial expression. Her chin is tilted distinctly upward as she looks downward at the viewer through heavy, half-closed eyelids. Her eyebrows sit in smooth, unbothered arches above an unwrinkled forehead. Her lips are pressed together into a wide, self-satisfied smile that curls up firmly at both corners.

Snarling.prompt: A snarling facial expression. Her upper lip is pulled sharply upward and back, exposing her upper front teeth, canine, and reddish gumline. The bridge of her nose is heavily scrunched into deep vertical skin folds, and her nostrils are flared wide. Her eyebrows are drawn low and violently inward over narrowed, glaring eyes.

Sneering.prompt: A sneering facial expression. One side of her upper lip curls upward in an asymmetrical lift, displaying her single upper canine tooth in a cold grimace. Her nose is wrinkled unevenly on that same side while her chin tilts back slightly. Her eyelids droop into a flat, dismissive stare beneath level, unmoving eyebrows.

Surprised.prompt: A surprised facial expression. Her eyebrows are hitched high up her forehead into smooth, clean arches, creating distinct horizontal forehead wrinkles. Her eyes are opened wide into full circles, exposing white sclera above and around her irises. Her lower jaw drops down smoothly, parting her lips into a tall, relaxed oval 'O' shape.

Suspicious.prompt: A suspicious facial expression. Her eyes are narrowed into sharp, tight slits as her gaze shifts sideways out of the corners of her eyelids without moving her head. One eyebrow is drawn down into a slight furrow while the other remains flat and raised. Her lips are pressed into a tight, thin horizontal line with one jaw muscle tense.

Terrified.prompt: A terrified facial expression. Her eyes are stretched to their absolute physical limits, showing wide rings of white sclera surrounding her dilated pupils. Her eyebrows are pulled sky-high and forced together into a strained, jagged knot across her creased forehead. Her mouth is torn open into a wide, breathless gasp with taut, visible neck tendons.

Thoughtful.prompt: A thoughtful facial expression. Her eyes are cast slightly upward and off-center in a focused, contemplative stare away from the camera. A faint vertical furrow appears between her eyebrows, while the rest of her forehead remains completely smooth. Her lips are softly closed together, with the tip of one index finger resting lightly against her chin.

Wry.prompt: A wry facial expression. Her lips are drawn into a crooked, dry half-smile where one corner is tugged upward while the other dips downward slightly. Her eyelids are narrowed in a subtle, amused squint framed by faint crow's feet at the outer temples. Her head is tilted to one side with one eyebrow raised in a gentle arch.

Aggressive.prompt: An aggressive facial expression. Her eyebrows are driven steeply downward toward the bridge of her nose, forming a deep V-shaped knot above her glare. Her nostrils are flared wide, and her jaw is thrust forward with masseter muscles visibly bulging at the cheeks. Her upper lip is lifted tautly away from her front teeth in a tight, bared grimace.

Amazed.prompt: An amazed facial expression. Her eyebrows are arched high up toward her hairline, smoothing her forehead into wide, clean horizontal creases. Her eyes are enlarged and glossy, with wide-open pupils capturing full light. Her lips are parted in an open, gentle 'O' of wonder, revealing the tips of her upper front teeth.

Angry.prompt: An angry facial expression. Deep vertical creases are carved into the space between her eyebrows as they are pulled low and tightly together over burning eyes. Her nostrils are dilated wide, and her lips are pressed flatly into a hard, rigid horizontal line that hides her lips' fullness. Her chin is set firm and rigid, pulling the skin tight across her jawline.

Annoyed.prompt: An annoyed facial expression. Her eyelids droop into a heavy, unamused flat stare while one eyebrow is drawn down into a minor central furrow. Her lips are compressed tightly into a straight line, with air occasionally puffing her lower lip outward in a silent huff. Her head turns slightly away from the viewer with a stiff, rigid neck posture.

Anxious.prompt: An anxious facial expression. Her inner eyebrows are drawn upward and squeezed together, forming tense vertical lines above the bridge of her nose. Her lower eyelids are pulled taut and her gaze darts rapidly from side to side without staying fixed. Her lower lip is drawn inward, caught tightly between her front teeth as her throat muscles tense.

Ecstatic.prompt: An ecstatic facial expression. Her face is illuminated by a massive, open-mouthed grin that pulls her cheeks high into prominent, full round apples. Her eyes are squeezed shut into tight, happy crescent slits framed by deep fan-like crow's feet at her temples. Her head is thrown back slightly with an upturned chin and arched eyebrows.

Embarrassed.prompt: An embarrassed facial expression. A dark crimson flush covers her cheekbones, bridge of her nose, and upper chest area. Her eyes are turned downward and away from the viewer beneath drawn, sheepish eyebrows with raised inner corners. Her teeth bite gently into the side of her lower lip while her head dips low toward her shoulder.

Exasperated.prompt: An exasperated facial expression. Her head is thrown backward as her eyes roll straight up toward the ceiling with exposed white sclera below her irises. Her mouth drops open into a deep exhale, blowing air outward across her lips. Her eyebrows sit flat and heavy across her forehead while her entire face sags in total irritation.

Excited.prompt: An excited facial expression. Her eyes are opened wide and sparkling, with fully expanded pupils looking directly forward. Her mouth is curved into a massive, open-lipped toothy smile with cheeks drawn high into full round balls. Her eyebrows are arched sky-high, smoothing her forehead into clear horizontal lines.

Impressed.prompt: An impressed facial expression. Her eyebrows are elevated high up her forehead into clean arches as her eyes widen slightly with focused interest. Her lips are pressed together and pushed forward into a subtle nod of approval, curving slightly downward at the corners. Her chin tilts upward slightly while her head nods forward slowly.

Innocent.prompt: An innocent facial expression. Her upper eyelids are opened wide to reveal clear, full irises without any eye strain or forehead creasing. Her eyebrows are raised softly into smooth, even curves. Her mouth is held lightly closed in a soft, natural curve, with cheeks resting completely relaxed.

Unimpressed.prompt: An unimpressed facial expression. Her eyelids droop heavy and flat over her pupils in a dull, unblinking glare. One of her eyebrows is drawn down into a slight, bored furrow while the other rests flat. Her mouth is compressed into a rigid, unmoving horizontal line with slightly downturned corners.

Raised Eyebrows.prompt: Raised eyebrows. Both of her eyebrows are pulled high up toward her hairline, creating parallel horizontal wrinkles across the entire span of her forehead. Her upper eyelids are retracted to expose the full curve of her irises and top white sclera. Her mouth remains closed in a relaxed, neutral posture.

Wrinkled Nose.prompt: Wrinkling her nose. Deep, tight vertical and diagonal skin folds scrunch tightly along the bridge and sides of her nose. Her upper lip is drawn upward slightly, exposing the tips of her upper front teeth. Her lower eyelids are scrunched upward into a heavy squint with small creases at the inner eye corners.

Yelling.prompt: Yelling. Her lower jaw is unhinged and pulled wide downward into a massive vertical rectangle, exposing her flattened tongue and throat. Her neck tendons stand out like rigid cords beneath taut skin as air is violently expelled. Her nostrils are flared wide, and her eyebrows are drawn low and furrowed sharply over wide, staring eyes.

Sneezing.prompt: A tight lipped smile facial expression. Her lips are pulled sideways and flattened tautly against her teeth into a thin horizontal line without exposing any teeth. The corners of her mouth are tugged slightly upward into her cheeks, creating mild dimples. Her eyes remain widened and relaxed, framed by smooth, level eyebrows.

Wincing.prompt: A pressed lips facial expression. Her upper and lower lips are compressed firmly against each other, rolling slightly inward to hide the pink vermilion border entirely. Her jawline is set stiff and unclenched, while her cheeks sit still without dimpling. Her eyebrows rest flat and horizontal over steady, neutral eyes.

Gritting Teeth.prompt: A lip quiver facial expression. Her lower lip trembles with rapid, fine muscular spasms, pushing slightly outward into a fragile pout. Her chin skin puckers into a tight, pebbled orange-peel texture beneath her mouth. Her inner eyebrows are pulled upward and together, with wet tear drops glistening on her lower eyelashes.

Licking Lips.prompt: A jaw clenched facial expression. Masseter muscles bulge visibly at the rear corners of her jawline under tight, strained skin. Her teeth are locked firmly together behind tightly sealed, thin lips. Her lower eyelids are tensed straight, and her eyebrows are pulled into a hard, focused horizontal line across her brow.

Blowing Kiss.prompt: A slight grimace facial expression. The corners of her mouth are tugged sideways and downward into a taut, asymmetrical strain, revealing a sliver of her bottom teeth. Her eyes are narrowed into a minor squint, creasing the skin at the outer temples. Her eyebrows dip slightly in the center over tense cheek muscles.

Bittersweet.prompt: A one eyebrow raised facial expression. One eyebrow is arched high up her forehead into a distinct, sharp curve, creating localized horizontal wrinkles above that eye. Her opposite eyebrow remains completely flat and lowered over a narrowed, skeptical eye. Her lips are set in a subtle, dry horizontal line with one corner tugged up slightly.

Disappointed.prompt: A fleeting smile facial expression. The corners of her lips make a brief, delicate upward twitch before instantly relaxing back into a neutral horizontal seam. Her eyelids narrow for a fraction of a second with faint crow's feet before opening back to normal. Her cheek muscles show a momentary, subtle rise across the cheekbones.

Cringing.prompt: A micro frown facial expression. The inner corners of her eyebrows experience a sharp, momentary twitch downward and together, forming a split-second vertical crease above her nose bridge. Her eyelids tense slightly around her irises before immediately relaxing. Her lips remain completely motionless in a flat, unmoving line.

Guilty.prompt: A half smile facial expression. Only one side of her mouth curves upward into a distinct grin, lifting that cheek and dimpling the skin. The opposite side of her mouth remains completely neutral, low, and resting. Her eyes are relaxed, with the eyelid on the smiling side subtly crinkling at the outer corner.

Manic.prompt: An asymmetrical smile facial expression. Her mouth is pulled into an uneven, crooked grin where the left lip corner lifts high toward her cheekbone to reveal upper teeth, while the right corner stays closed and low. Her cheeks rise to different heights, and one eyebrow sits faintly higher than the other.

Vacant.prompt: A polite smile facial expression. Her lips are pressed together into a clean, closed-mouth smile that curves gently upward at both corners without revealing any teeth. Her cheeks show a mild upward lift, but her eyes remain wide, smooth, and un-crinkled without crow's feet. Her eyebrows sit resting in a calm, level position.

Condescending.prompt: A forced smile facial expression. Her mouth is stretched wide into a rigid toothy grin showing both rows of teeth, but her upper face remains completely static and unengaged. Her eyes are wide and unblinking, with zero crinkling or crow's feet at the outer corners. Her cheek muscles are held up in a stiff, mechanical tension.

Yawning.prompt: An awkward smile facial expression. Her lips are drawn back flat against her teeth in a tight, tense line showing a sliver of front incisors while her jaw remains tense. Her head tilts slightly sideways with her neck tight, and her inner eyebrows are pulled up subtly in the center in sheepish discomfort. Her eyes look directly forward with wide, uneasy pupils.

Tight Lipped Smile.prompt: An apologetic facial expression. Her inner eyebrows are drawn upward and together into a soft central peak, slanting downward toward her temples. Her eyes gaze gently at the viewer with wide, soft pupils, while her lips are pressed into a small, tense horizontal line with slightly downturned corners. Her head dips downward in a sheepish tilt.

Pressed Lips.prompt: An attentive listening facial expression. Her head is tilted slightly forward and to one side, holding a steady, focused gaze on the speaker with wide, clear eyes. Her eyebrows are lifted in a smooth, subtle arch without creasing her forehead. Her lips are softly closed in a relaxed, receptive curve with zero jaw tension.

Lip Quiver.prompt: A bored facial expression. Her eyelids droop heavy and half-closed over unfocused pupils, casting a shadow across her eyes. Her eyebrows sit completely flat and relaxed with zero curvature across her forehead. Her chin rests heavy in the palm of her hand as her mouth hangs in a slack, slightly open horizontal line.

Jaw Clenched.prompt: A distracted facial expression. Her eyes are turned away from the camera, staring blankly into empty space with unfocused, wide pupils. Her eyebrows rest in a neutral, uncreased position over relaxed eyelids. Her lower jaw is slightly slack, leaving her lips softly parted without any tension around her mouth or cheeks.

Slight Grimace.prompt: A curious facial expression. Her head is tilted sharply to one side while one of her eyebrows arches upward higher than the other. Her eyes are narrowed slightly into a focused squint, targeting an object off-center. Her lips are parted into a tiny, relaxed oval 'O' shape, revealing a sliver of her upper front teeth.

One Eyebrow Raised.prompt: An expectant facial expression. Her eyes are wide and glossy, capturing full light with elevated upper eyelids and centered pupils. Her eyebrows sit high on a smooth forehead in clean, expectant arches. Her lips are softly parted with the corners pulled up into a subtle, hopeful smile as her chin points slightly forward.

Fleeting Smile.prompt: A resigned facial expression. Her gaze is cast downward toward the floor with heavy eyelids and slightly drooping eyebrows. Her lips are compressed into a flat, downturned horizontal line with the corners of her mouth pulled low. Her shoulders sag as a soft exhale causes her cheeks to briefly deflate.

Micro Frown.prompt: A restrained anger facial expression. Her lips are pressed into an ultra-thin, razor-sharp line with jaw muscles visibly bulging at the rear of her cheeks. Her nostrils flex slightly open while her eyebrows are held forcibly level over burning, narrowed eyes. The skin across her bridge of the nose and forehead remains taut with restricted muscle strain.

Half Smile.prompt: A suppressed laughter facial expression. Her lips are pressed tightly together into a strained smile while her cheeks puff outward with trapped air. Deep fan-like crow's feet crinkle the outer corners of her eyes, which are squeezed semi-shut with tears forming at the lashes. Her throat muscles strain as she resists opening her mouth.

Asymmetrical Smile.prompt: A restrained disgust facial expression. A tiny micro-wrinkle bunches the skin along the bridge of her nose for a fraction of a second. Her lower lip twitches briefly outward into a faint pout while her upper eyelids narrow into a tight, guarded squint. Her jaw clamps tightly closed, pulling the skin flat along her jawline.

Polite Smile.prompt: A suppressed sadness facial expression. Her chin muscle puckers tightly into an orange-peel texture while her lips are forced into a flat, rigid bar to stop their trembling. Her inner eyebrows are drawn upward and together into a subtle peak. Her eyelids are tensed straight, holding back moisture as her eyes gaze rapidly upward.

Forced Smile.prompt: A mild irritation facial expression. A single faint vertical furrow appears between her eyebrows as they dip slightly in the center. Her lips are pressed together with one corner sitting lower than the other in a subtle, uneven line. Her eyes narrow into a brief, deliberate blink before returning to a flat, level gaze.

Awkward Smile.prompt: A weary facial expression. Heavy dark circles frame her deeply drooped upper eyelids, which barely expose her downcast pupils. Her eyebrows sit low and flat across a dull brow without any elevation. The corners of her mouth sag downward into a slack curve, and the skin around her cheeks appears heavy and loose.

Apologetic.prompt: A fed up facial expression. Her eyes roll dramatically upward into her eyelids as a deep exhale puffs her lower lip outward. Her eyebrows sit flat and drawn straight across her forehead without curving. Her head tilts backward slightly as her jaw drops into a heavy, annoyed sigh.

Attentive Listening.prompt: A defeated facial expression. Her head hangs low with her chin tucked toward her chest, her dull eyes staring blankly at the ground without blinking. Her eyelids droop low over unfocused irises, while her forehead remains slack and expressionless. Her mouth rests slightly open with a completely limp, unengaged jawline.

Bored.prompt: An uncomfortable facial expression. Her eyes dart rapidly sideways away from the viewer while her neck tendons pull tense beneath her skin. Her lips are compressed together and pulled awkwardly to one side of her face. Her eyebrows are drawn inward into a shallow, uncertain furrow above her narrowed eyelids.

Distracted.prompt: An uneasy facial expression. Her lower eyelids are pulled taut and flat beneath eyebrows that sit slightly furrowed and angled downward in the center. Her lips are pressed into a strained, rigid horizontal line that pulls at the corners of her mouth. Her head stays stiff and unmoving as her eyes scan forward cautiously.

Curious.prompt: A confident facial expression. Her head is held tall and level, with her chin slightly elevated and eyes focused directly forward in an unblinking, steady gaze. Her eyebrows rest in relaxed, clean arches over open eyelids. A calm, easy, closed-mouth smile lifts both corners of her lips evenly, dimpling her cheeks softly.

Expectant.prompt: A self assured facial expression. Her chin points subtly upward as her eyelids rest in a relaxed, comfortable posture over steady pupils. Her eyebrows sit smooth and level without any forehead wrinkles. Her lips are curved upward into a faint, smooth smile tucked neatly into the corners of her mouth, radiating quiet composure.

Resigned.prompt: A defiant facial expression. Her head is pushed forward with her chin raised high, forced into an unyielding, assertive posture. Her jaw is set firm with masseter muscles taut, while her nostrils flex wide. Her eyes stare hard and unblinking from beneath steeply lowered, furrowed eyebrows.

Restrained Anger.prompt: A challenging stare facial expression. Her head tilts down slightly as her eyes glare upward directly at the viewer beneath intense, lowered brows. Her eyebrows are driven together into a tight knot above the bridge of her nose. Her mouth is closed tautly into an unmoving horizontal line, with her jaw set completely rigid.

Suppressed Laughter.prompt: A commanding facial expression. Her eyes are wide, intense, and completely fixed forward, surrounded by unwrinkled skin and smooth eyelids. Her eyebrows sit level, firm, and unmoving across a smooth, strong forehead. Her lips are set in a strong, unyielding horizontal line, while her chin is held completely level and steady.

Restrained Disgust.prompt: An intimidating facial expression. Shadowed eyes stare unblinkingly from beneath deeply lowered, heavy brows that form a dark brow ridge. Her face is completely devoid of any smile or warmth, with her jaw set stone-hard and masseter muscles taut. Her head tilts forward slightly, casting a piercing upward glare.

Suppressed Sadness.prompt: A dismissive facial expression. Her head turns away from center while her upper eyelids droop lazily, allowing her eyes to flick sideways away from the viewer. Her eyebrows remain flat and unbothered, while one corner of her mouth curls into a tiny, brief sneer before flattening.

Mild Irritation.prompt: A patronizing facial expression. Her head is tilted back to look down her nose at the viewer, framed by an exaggeratedly sweet, closed-lip smile. Her eyebrows are raised mockingly high in smooth arches, and her eyelids are half-closed in a lingering, smug gaze.

Weary.prompt: A triumphant facial expression. Her head is thrown back with her mouth open wide in a victorious shout showing both upper and lower teeth. Her eyes are squeezed shut into happy, triumphant arcs, and her cheek muscles are pulled exceptionally high and flushed.

Fed Up.prompt: A victorious facial expression. Her eyes are wide, glowing, and elevated with high pupils, while a broad, open-mouthed grin shows her full upper row of teeth. Her eyebrows are arched high on a smooth forehead, and her entire face is lifted in an energetic rise.

Defeated.prompt: A vulnerable facial expression. Her eyes are wide and moist, looking directly up at the viewer with fully visible irises. Her lips are soft, pale, and slightly parted, while her eyebrows are drawn up subtly in the center with a gentle central furrow.

Uncomfortable.prompt: A tender facial expression. Soft, relaxed eyelids frame warm, gentle eyes that focus directly forward. Her eyebrows are softly arched without a single line of tension across her forehead, and her lips rest in a subtle, smooth-lipped smile.

Uneasy.prompt: An empathetic facial expression. Her head tilts gently to the side, with the inner corners of her eyebrows drawn up soft and high in concern. Her eyes focus warmly and steadily on the viewer, while her lips are set in a soft, compassionate, closed-mouth curve.

Confident.prompt: A compassionate facial expression. Her eyebrows are slightly furrowed with raised inner corners, framing a warm, deeply focused gaze. Her face is soft with a gentle closed-lip smile that lifts her cheekbones slightly and relaxes her jaw completely.

Self Assured.prompt: An affectionate facial expression. Her eyes narrow softly into crescent shapes, crinkling gently at the outer edges under smooth eyebrows. Her cheeks rise into full, warm curves as a full smile reveals her upper front teeth with soft lighting across her face.

Defiant.prompt: A comforting facial expression. Her eyebrows rest soft and flat across a calm forehead, while her eyes are wide, clear, and reassuring. Her lips are relaxed into a gentle, soft closed-mouth smile that softens her entire jaw and chin line.

Challenging Stare.prompt: A hopeful facial expression. Her eyes are wide and angled slightly upward, catching the light with clear pupils and raised upper eyelids. Her eyebrows are lifted softly into smooth arches, and a bright, subtle smile blooms across her parted lips.

Commanding.prompt: A longing facial expression. Her lips are parted softly in a breathy gap, her eyes wide and glistening as they look off into the distance. Her eyebrows are drawn up subtly in the middle, creating a faint, wistful angle across her forehead.

Intimidating.prompt: A nostalgic facial expression. Her gaze drops softly downward and to the side, illuminated by a gentle, wistful half-smile on closed lips. Her eyebrows sit relaxed and smooth, and her cheeks show a light, soft warmth.

Dismissive.prompt: A reflective facial expression. Her eyes are turned downward and slightly off-center in a calm, inward-focused gaze. Her lips are lightly sealed in a neutral posture, her forehead is completely uncreased, and her facial muscles rest in serene balance.

Patronizing.prompt: A biting inner cheek facial expression. One side of her cheek is sucked inward between her molars, pulling that corner of her mouth into a deep, hollow dimple. Her opposite lip corner rests neutral while her eyes narrow slightly in concentrated thought.

Triumphant.prompt: Pursed lips facial expression. Her upper and lower lips are puckered and pressed tightly together into a small, rounded, wrinkled ring protruding forward. Her cheek muscles pull inward toward her mouth, while her eyes remain steady under level brows.

Victorious.prompt: A chewing on lip facial expression. Her upper front teeth continually nibble and shift along the fleshy surface of her lower lip, which is drawn inward. Her eyebrows are drawn into a slight, thoughtful furrow over focused, downcast eyes.

Vulnerable.prompt: Flared nostrils facial expression. The outer wings of her nostrils are pulled wide open, expanding her nasal openings into large, rigid circles. Her bridge of the nose is smooth, but her lips are pressed tight and her eyes remain fixed and unblinking.

Tender.prompt: A squinting facial expression. Her lower and upper eyelids are pulled tightly toward each other, narrowing her eye openings to thin horizontal slits. Fine wrinkles crinkle outward at her temples, while her eyebrows dip low over her brow.

Empathetic.prompt: A wide eyed stare facial expression. Her eyelids are retracted fully back into her eye sockets, exposing a complete ring of white sclera surrounding her pupils. Her eyebrows are raised high without frowning, and her mouth remains completely still and closed.

Compassionate.prompt: Narrowed eyes facial expression. Her upper eyelids droop low while her lower eyelids are raised firmly upward, squeezing her eyes into sharp, razor-thin slits. Her eyebrows sit flat and heavy over her brow line, framing a sharp, calculating gaze.

Affectionate.prompt: A mouth slightly open facial expression. Her lower jaw is relaxed downward, leaving a soft half-inch gap between her un-tensioned lips. Her front upper teeth are barely visible in the dark opening, while her eyelids and eyebrows rest in a completely natural posture.

Comforting.prompt: Lips parted facial expression. Her upper and lower lips separate subtly by a few millimeters, revealing the moist edge of her lower lip and front incisors. Her breath passes softly through the gap while her cheeks and eyelids remain slack.

Nostalgic.prompt: A blank stare facial expression. Unblinking, wide eyes look directly forward without focusing on any specific object. Her eyelid rims rest neutral, her forehead is completely smooth, and her lips sit motionless and slack.

Reflective.prompt: A thousand yard stare facial expression. Her eyes are open wide but completely unfocused, staring straight through the viewer into empty space. Her eyebrows are slack, her eyelids do not blink, and her lower jaw hangs limp and expressionless.

Biting Inner Cheek.prompt: An uncanny smile facial expression. Her mouth is stretched into an unnaturally wide, hyper-extended grin showing full upper and lower gums and teeth. Her eyes, however, remain completely wide, unblinking, flat, and un-wrinkled without any warmth.

Pursed Lips.prompt: A fake laugh facial expression. Her mouth is open wide in a forced laughing oval exposing both rows of teeth, but her upper face remains completely static. Her eyes are wide and un-crinkled, her cheeks are stiffly elevated, and her brow is unmoving.

Squinting.prompt: A dissociated facial expression. Her eyes are completely motionless and vacant, staring blankly ahead with heavy, drooping eyelids. Her forehead and brow show zero muscular tone, and her mouth hangs softly open with a limp jaw.

Puffed Cheeks.prompt: Licking her lips. The pink tip of her tongue extends outward and sweeps smoothly along the outer border of her lower and upper lips. Her eyes remain focused forward, framed by relaxed eyelids and smooth, soft eyebrows.

Deadpan.prompt: Blowing a kiss. Her lips are pursed tightly together into a small, rounded 'O' shape extending forward toward the viewer. One eye winks shut in a playful crease while her opposite eyebrow raises high on her forehead.

Blank Stare.prompt: A bittersweet facial expression. A gentle, sad smile turns the corners of her lips upward, while her inner eyebrows are pulled up and together in emotional pain. Her eyes glisten with unshed tears beneath soft, heavy eyelids.

Thousand Yard Stare.prompt: A disappointed facial expression. Her eyelids are heavy and cast downward, while the corners of her mouth sag into a clear downturned curve. Her eyebrows sit flat and lowered over her eyes, and her jawline sags slightly.

Uncanny Smile.prompt: A cringing facial expression. Her head pulls back sharply into her neck as her eyes squinch shut and her shoulders draw up. Her mouth is twisted into an asymmetrical, pained grimace that exposes her clenched teeth.

Dissociated.prompt: A condescending facial expression. Her head is angled upward to look down along her nose at the viewer, eyelids drooped in cool bored indifference. A small, lopsided smirk curls one corner of her lip upward while her forehead stays smooth.
